items.title: Migrants paid up to $500 million in smuggling fees on European sea routes
items.summary: The price tag for smuggling on European sea routes reached up to half a billion dollars last year, the UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the UN migration office, IOM, reported on Wednesday.

items.title: World News in Brief: Aid for Ethiopia, Abyei drone strikes condemned, extreme heat and newborn health
items.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) is scaling up emergency health response operations across Afar, Amhara and Tigray in Ethiopia to address growing humanitarian and health needs resulting from ongoing hostilities.

items.title: ‘Ominous start’ to West Bank olive harvest amid settler attacks
items.summary: The use of live ammunition, arson and the destruction of centuries-old olive trees have marked the opening weeks of this year’s harvest in the occupied West Bank.

items.title: Fate unknown of many returned to DPR Korea from China: UN independent experts
items.summary: Three years on from the reported resumption of large-scale forcible returns of nationals of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) from China, serious concerns persist about their fate, according to a group of Human Rights Council-appointed independent experts.

items.title: Katya Adler: France divided over who to blame for riots and what to learn from them
items.summary: In France and beyond there is widespread disagreement over what led to some of the worst unrest seen in French cities in modern history.
